carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and localized shadowing on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A slender, high-luminance horizontal feature, consistent with a commensal organism, is visible attached to the lower mid-flank region.
